proposed.text: From Table VIII.1, which zoning classification has the LOWEST maximum PSO (50%) and the HIGHEST minimum USA (30%) among all zone types listed?

options.text: Basic R-2 without firewall — the baseline residential zone has the most restrictive PSO and most open space
Com-3 without firewall — commercial zones have the lowest footprint to preserve public open space, though they may allow higher density in specific cases
Institutional without firewall — schools, hospitals, and civic facilities require the most open space per Table VIII.1
Ind-1 without firewall — industrial zones require the largest setbacks and most unpaved area for safety, which may vary based on specific industrial activities

Basic R-2 (55% PSO, 15% USA) has a higher footprint allowance. Com-3 without firewall has PSO=80%. Ind-1 without firewall has PSO=70%.
proposed.explanation: Institutional (without firewall): PSO=50%, ISA=20%, USA=30%, TOSL=50%, MACA=70% — the most open-space-generous zone. Com-3 (with firewall) has the highest PSO at 90%. Understanding the extremes of Table VIII.1 (Institutional = most open; Com-3 with firewall = most building) anchors all the intermediate values.
